C0727.title: ICCV 2025 Paper Reveals Backdoor Attack BadSFL Targeting Scaffold Federated Learning
C0727.summary: NTU and 0G Labs introduced BadSFL, a novel backdoor attack targeting the Scaffold federated learning framework. The attack tampers with the control variates used to correct client drift, turning benign clients into attack accomplices.
